#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an ICS calendar entry for a project kickoff meeting:
next Monday at 10:00 AM local time, 2 hours duration."""

import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone, date

# --- Determine local timezone ---
now_local = datetime.now().astimezone()
tz = now_local.tzinfo
tz_key = getattr(tz, "key", None)

# --- Compute "next Monday" (strictly after today, local calendar) ---
today = date.today()
days_ahead = (0 - today.weekday()) % 7  # Monday == 0
if days_ahead == 0:
    days_ahead = 7  # today is Monday -> next week's Monday
kickoff_date = today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)

# --- Build local 10:00-12:00 datetimes ---
if tz_key:
    import zoneinfo
    zone = zoneinfo.ZoneInfo(tz_key)
    local_start = datetime(kickoff_date.year, kickoff_date.month, kickoff_date.day, 10, 0, tzinfo=zone)
else:
    offset = now_local.utcoffset()
    local_start = datetime(kickoff_date.year, kickoff_date.month, kickoff_date.day, 10, 0, tzinfo=timezone(offset))
local_end = local_start + timedelta(hours=2)

start_utc = local_start.astimezone(timezone.utc)
end_utc = local_end.astimezone(timezone.utc)
stamp_utc = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

def fmt_utc(dt):
    return dt.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@calendar-skill"

ics = "\r\n".join([
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN",
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "METHOD:PUBLISH",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT",
    f"UID:{uid}",
    f"DTSTAMP:{fmt_utc(stamp_utc)}",
    f"DTSTART:{fmt_utc(start_utc)}",
    f"DTEND:{fmt_utc(end_utc)}",
    "SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting",
    "DESCRIPTION:Project kickoff meeting (10:00 AM - 12:00 PM local time)",
    "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
    "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
    "SEQUENCE:0",
    "BEGIN:VALARM",
    "ACTION:DISPLAY",
    "DESCRIPTION:Project Kickoff Meeting starts in 15 minutes",
    "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
    "END:VALARM",
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
    "",
])

out_path = "project_kickoff.ics"
with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    f.write(ics)

print(f"Created: {out_path}")
print(f"Kickoff date (local): {kickoff_date.isoformat()} ({kickoff_date.strftime('%A, %B %d, %Y')})")
print(f"Start (UTC): {fmt_utc(start_utc)}  ->  End (UTC): {fmt_utc(end_utc)}")
print(f"Local timezone: {tz_key or 'UTC offset ' + str(now_local.utcoffset())}")
